title: bomify plugin ContractResult
description: The single JSON object every bomify-plugin-<kind> binary must print to stdout on success for its "contract" subcommand, per plugins/README.md#contract-versions. Validate a plugin's actual stdout output (one line, one object) against this schema to check it for structural conformance.

contracts.description: Each plugin contract the plugin implements, mapped to the major version of it the plugin speaks. A contract it doesn't implement is absent.
